description: This file defines the MessageElement class which implements handling for <fail-message> and <fail-property> elements in OFBiz's MiniLang, used for processing and validating elements related to error messaging in the Mini language.

classes.name: MessageElement
classes.description: Implements handling of <fail-message> and <fail-property> elements within the MiniLang for defining error messages and properties.

methods.name: fromParentElement
methods.description: Factory method that creates a MessageElement based on the parent XML element; looks for either <fail-message> or <fail-property> child elements.

methods.name: MessageElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MessageElement based on the provided XML element and context, validating attributes and setting up message or property expanders.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the expanded message string based on the method context, either directly from 'message' attribute or by retrieving from properties resource.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MessageElement, reflecting its constructed XML snippet.
